PowerShell(Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object {$_.Status -ne 'Disabled'} | Select-Object Name, InterfaceDescription, Status, LinkSpeed | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-NetIPConfiguration -InterfaceAlias 'Ethernet','WiFi' | ForEach-Object { "`n=== $\($_.InterfaceAlias\) ==="; $_.IPv4Address | Select-Object IPAddress, PrefixLength; "Gateway : " + \($_.IPv4DefaultGateway.NextHop\); "DNS     : " + \(\($_.DNSServer | Where-Object {$_.AddressFamily -eq 2}\).ServerAddresses -join ', '\) })

PowerShell(foreach \($a in 'Ethernet','WiFi'\) { $c = Get-NetIPConfiguration -InterfaceAlias $a; "`n=== $a ==="; \($c.IPv4Address | Select-Object -ExpandProperty IPAddress\) -join ', ' | ForEach-Object {"IP      : $_"}; "Gateway : " + $c.IPv4DefaultGateway.NextHop; "DNS     : " + \(\($c.DNSServer | Where-Object {$_.AddressFamily -eq 2}\).ServerAddresses -join ', '\) })
PowerShell("-- 10 pings to gateway from Ethernet --")
